title: Rollout Wave Planner
brief: Config changes spread through a tree of servers, where each server feeds at most two servers below it. The release team deploys in waves: a wave contains every server at the same distance from the origin, and within a wave servers are listed as they appear from left to right in the tree.
Implement planRolloutWaves(root), where root is the TreeNode for the origin server and each node's value is a server id, and return the waves as a list of lists of ids, the origin's wave first.
